defect: a reset-synchronized control register and its consumer use independent asynchronous resets
rationale: state_o can reset under rst_state while sync_q retains a different reset phase under rst_sync, so the consumer can observe a reset-domain transition inconsistent with its control state.
author: gpt-5.6-luna

provenance.adaptation: Reduced the reset pipeline to two stages and a separate stream-state consumer.

mutation.description: Assigned the consumer a separate asynchronous reset from the reset pipeline that controls its enable condition.

labels.by: claude-sonnet (blind second labeller, design and constraints only)
labels.note: state_o has its own unsynchronised async reset yet is enabled by sync_q in a different reset domain; release ordering undefined.
